data.name: Hoorain
data.gender_notes: Hoorain is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dual of ḥawrāʾ, from the Arabic root ح-و-ر (ḥ-w-r); ḥūr ʿīn are the maidens of paradise described in the Qur'an. Its root is ح-و-ر (ḥ-w-r). A Qur'anic concept (ḥūr ʿīn). Hoorain is a Arabic name meaning “Two beautiful-eyed maidens of paradise”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hoorain expresses “Two beautiful-eyed maidens of paradise”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Dual of ḥawrāʾ, from the Arabic root ح-و-ر (ḥ-w-r); ḥūr ʿīn are the maidens of paradise described in the Qur'an.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hoorain total 44, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
